description: Persons (Portal users), declared not_served until the reporting API serves app_user (owner directive 2db2fe9bf1f8 PT7). Every Person value is pii-marked.

object_types.description: A Portal user: an employee (ADMIN .. ACCOUNTING roles) or a customer/supplier portal login (CUSTOMER, SUPPLIER). Bindings and links are declared and tested in ontology/schema/pending/people_lots.json, which replaces this placeholder when loaded with include_pending. BC contacts stay the Contact type.

availability.reason: Pending: the reporting-API allowlist (services/workbench-api/manifest/allowlist.json@790256ca43) does not serve public.app_user (nor app_person/people): Portal users are not readable, so a person appears only as an id or a name typed in another record.

prisma.user.note: User -> app_user: unique email, name/firstName/lastName, phone, jobTitle, userRole UserRole, departmentId, isActive, Entra ids, password/2FA/reset secrets.
